site.title: {project} - Sherem Faea i No Gat Wan Senta
site.description: {project} hemi wan peer-to-peer faea sherem softwea we i bilt long modan teknoloji we i no gat wan senta.
site.ogTitle: {project} - Faea sherem softwea we i no gat wan senta
site.ogDescription: Peer-to-peer faea sherem we i bilt long modan teknoloji we i no gat wan senta. I no gat ol senta seva. I no gat wan ples we i save fol daon.

hero.subtitle: Niu jenereisen blong peer-to-peer faea sherem
hero.description: I bilt long modan teknoloji we i no gat wan senta. I no gat ol senta seva. I no gat wan ples we i save fol daon.

about.title: Long
about.intro: {project} hemi wan niu jenereisen peer-to-peer faea sherem platfom we i bilt long modan teknoloji we i no gat wan senta. Hemi joenem wan ezi yusa interfes mo wan fulwan akitektja we i no gat wan senta, hemi givim wan sef mo trastfulwan rod blong sherem dato we hemi indipenden long evri senta otoriti. Projek ya i open source mo i kasem evriwan andanit long {license}.

decentralized.title: Fulwan netwak we i no gat wan senta
decentralized.description: I no gat ol senta seva, i no gat wan ples we i save fol daon. Ol yusa oli lukaot mo daonlod ol kontent stret bitwin olgeta nomo, oli no nidim ol senta indekser, traka o database.

accessControl.title: Smol smol kontrol blong akses
accessControl.description: Evriwan i fri blong statem hem nomo netwak wetem ol loa blong hem nomo. Difaenem ol rol blong yusa long evri netwak: ol ona, ol admin, ol pablisa, ol moderata mo ol daonloda. Kontrolem stret hu i save pablisem, moderatem mo daonlod ol kontent.

ui.title: Bigwan kwoliti yusa interfes
ui.description: Wan klin mo ezi blong yus midia senta interfes we i bin meikim blong desktop, TV mo mobael platfom. Muvmuv smut wetem kibod, maus, gamepad o rimot kontrol. Ol pawa yusa oli save yusum komand laen interfes blong yusum softwea olsem wan hedles faea seva.

dataFormat.title: Dato fomat we man i save rid
dataFormat.description: Dato fomat blong LISH i bilt long JSON, mekem hemi izi blong meikim, ridim mo andastandem. Sherem ol kontent blong yu wetem klia mo opin metadata we evriwan i save jekem izi.

security.title: Praevet mo sefti
security.description: Evri peer-to-peer komunikesen i enkripted, i mekem sua se dato blong yu i stap praevet long taem blong transfa. Ol yusa oli save haed bihaen long wan VPN blong wan eksra leya blong i no save name. {project} i respektem praeveti blong yu long disaen.

crossPlatform.title: Kros platfom
crossPlatform.description: Softwea i avelebol blong Windows, Linux mo macOS platfom. Yusum hem long eni divaes we yu wantem.

download.title: Daonlod
download.description: Kasem {project} blong platfom blong yu. Evri daonlod oli fri mo open source.

macos.title: Impoten not blong ol macOS yusa:
macos.intro: macOS Gatekeeper i blokem ol app we oli no saen / no notarael we i daonlod long intanet wetem wan {error} eror.
macos.error: "i nogud mo i no save open"
macos.runCommand: Afta yu daonlod DMG o ZIP, ronem wan komand long Terminal long fasin ya bifo yu opem app:
macos.exampleDmg: Olsem eksampol, afta installesen long DMG:
macos.explanation: Hemia i tekemaot kuarentin atribut mo i letem app i ron.
